## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION. Breadth: 7/11 sectors positive. Confirmation 1: broad sector participation but Confirmation 2: mega-cap Tech names are universally BELOW TREND (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META), creating conflicting signals; Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

2. Which sectors are leading?
Materials lead: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND; Industrials strong: CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare leadership: ABBV (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND and TMO (1W: +9.54% | 1M: +12.96%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology lagging: AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -8.79%) BELOW TREND. Communication weak: NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND and META (1W: -4.35% | 1M: -11.26%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND; ABBV (1W: +9.90% | 1M: +14.09%) ABOVE TREND; INTC (1W: +9.72% | 1M: +7.57%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND; BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND; PFE (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%) BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -9.06% | 1M: -2.42%) BELOW TREND; NEM (1W: -9.77% | 1M: -14.37%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across Communication, Financials and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +10.58% | 1M: +16.34%) ABOVE TREND. No major 1W/1M divergences among megacaps; watch for follow-through.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is in retreat with broad dispersion. AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) BELOW TREND; Sector (24 stocks) 1W: -2.62% indicating internal stress.

8. Financials Outlook?
Mixed/rotational. JPM (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND and V (1W: +0.04% | 1M: +1.24%) ABOVE TREND contrast with BLK (1W: -8.08% | 1M: -9.28%) BELOW TREND and CME (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -19.95%) BELOW TREND; Financials (20 stocks) 1W: -0.27% — internal rotation, monitor credit-sensitive names.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Defensive leadership intact. JNJ (1W: +4.56% | 1M: +6.39%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +4.00% | 1M: +10.89%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.41% | 1M: +5.91%) ABOVE TREND while PFE (1W: -8.68% | 1M: -8.43%) BELOW TREND shows idiosyncratic risk; Healthcare (17 stocks) 1W: +3.61%.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor Value/Cyclical style given Materials and Industrials leadership and mixed Tech; reduce exposure to large-cap Tech names showing uniform BELOW TREND. Monitor Financials for idiosyncratic opportunities (JPM showing strength) and watch Healthcare for defensive balance.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND; JPM (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND; DD (1W: +187.38% | 1M: +178.61%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: AAPL (1W: -7.03% | 1M: -10.76%) BELOW TREND; MSFT (1W: -6.88% | 1M: -15.19%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -7.87% | 1M: -19.14%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Materials (1W: +16.20%, 11 stocks) and Industrials (1W: +1.53%, 15 stocks). BEARISH: Technology (1W: -2.62%, 24 stocks) and Consumer Discretionary (1W: -1.46%, 14 stocks).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch AMAT for continuation above this week’s breakout to validate tech-equipment strength; watch AAPL for further downside confirmation after this week’s breakdown; watch JPM for follow-through on buyback/dividend catalyst to confirm Financials participation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
JPM (+90): Dividend hike and $50B buyback; price confirms strength — JPM (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +9.25%) ABOVE TREND. AMAT (+55): New chipmaking systems headline; price confirms — AMAT (1W: +12.66% | 1M: +46.85%) ABOVE TREND. ORCL (+55): headline-driven lift but price diverges — ORCL (1W: -16.93% | 1M: -21.03%) BELOW TREND (distribution, watch for follow-through).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PLTR (-45): headline on big declines; price confirms — PLTR (1W: -17.88% | 1M: -21.47%) BELOW TREND. TSLA (-45): negative headline flow and price confirms stress — TSLA (1W: -5.36% | 1M: -13.49%) BELOW TREND. MA (-40): regulatory pressure; price shows minor weakness — MA (1W: -0.83% | 1M: -0.83%) BELOW TREND.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION with a Value/Cyclical style tilt. DD, AMAT, CAT, ABBV and JPM are showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND). Key risk: broad CAUTION driven by 7/11 sector breadth positive but mega-cap Tech uniformly BELOW TREND and several bullish headlines (ORCL) diverging from price.
